description: This file defines data transfer objects (DTOs) and enums related to Out of Office (OOO) entries, including creation, updating, and filtering of OOO records, with validation and serialization logic.

classes.name: CreateOutOfOfficeEntryDto
classes.description: DTO for creating an out of office entry, including start/end dates, notes, user coverage, and reason.

classes.name: UpdateOutOfOfficeEntryDto
classes.description: DTO for updating an existing out of office entry, extending creation DTO with partial fields.

classes.name: GetOutOfOfficeEntryFiltersDTO
classes.description: DTO for filtering out of office entries with optional sorting parameters.

classes.name: GetOrgUsersOutOfOfficeEntryFiltersDTO
classes.description: Extends filtering DTO to include email filtering for organization users' out of office entries.

methods.name: isDateString
methods.description: Validates if a string matches ISO 8601 date format.
